_comment: Copy this file to student_profile.json and edit it for your student. student_profile.json is gitignored — it never leaves your machine. Claude Code reads it to size and aim every week it writes.
name: Alex
reading_level: Reads simple sentences independently; still sounds out longer words.
writing_level: Writes short sentences; gets tired after about three lines of writing.
notes: Loves hands-on and outdoor activities. Gets frustrated by long blocks of text — break reading into short chunks. Strong at counting and patterns; still shaky on subtraction.
